preconditions.description: The number of integers in the sequence is between 3 and 1000.
The matrix entries are between 0 and 5000.
The row and column to be changed is between 1 and N.
The new values for the matrix entries are between 0 and 5000.

postconditions.description: The first output line is the lexicographically smallest sequence that fits the initial matrix.
Each subsequent output line is the sequence that fits the matrix after the corresponding query.
